wholesale.title: The cookie your customers
wholesale.text: From épiceries fines and grocery shelves to café counters and office pantries. Shelf-ready packaging for retail, bulk cases for food service, and custom boxes for events.
wholesale.specs_note: UPC codes, nutrition facts and full ingredient lists are on our sell sheet. Contains wheat, milk and egg; Pistachio Stuffed contains tree nuts.
wholesale.why1_text: Individually wrapped singles and display trays that go straight from case to counter.
wholesale.why2_text: Bilingual English and French packaging on every product.
wholesale.why3_text: Shelf talkers, product photos and in-store tasting days for new stockists.
wholesale.why4_text: Standing orders and direct delivery across Greater Montréal.
wholesale.baked_text: Fully baked, wrapped or loose for display. Great for grab-and-go counters.
wholesale.frozen_text: Pre-portioned dough balls. Bake from frozen in 12 minutes for warm cookies all day.
wholesale.gift_text: Boxes with your logo, a printed note and your choice of flavours. For clients, teams and launches.
wholesale.white_text: Your brand, our bake. Recipe development and packaging support for larger accounts.
wholesale.step1_text: Tell us about your stores or business and volumes.
wholesale.step2_text: We send our sell sheet and a free sample box.
wholesale.step3_text: Simple case pricing, standing orders, 30-day terms.
wholesale.step4_text: Shelf talkers, photos and tasting days included.

story.title: Started in Nadia's kitchen,
story.text: What began as weekend batches for friends and family grew into a bakery supplying businesses and homes alike. The recipes haven't changed, and neither has the way we make them.
story.step1_text: Real butter, good chocolate in generous chunks, proper pistachio cream. No shortcuts.
story.step2_text: Every batch of dough rests for two days. It deepens the toffee flavour and gives that crisp-edge, soft-centre bite.
story.step3_text: We bake against orders, not forecasts, so nothing sits on a shelf. What arrives with you was dough a day or two ago.

testimonials.label: Testimonials
testimonials.q1: They outsell everything else on our counter. Customers ask for them by name.
testimonials.q2: Ordered a box of 12 for my mum's birthday. Gone in a day. Ordering again.
testimonials.q3: The frozen dough is a game-changer. Warm cookies all afternoon with zero waste.
